summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the new multi-step Event Creation wizard (create-event.tsx) and its integration with schedule/event-detail via the in-memory store. Tested both paid and simple flows end-to-end at 390x844. All 11 requested feature checks PASS. Deprecated packages check: none of the flagged deprecated packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) are used in create-event.tsx; only the ignorable pointerEvents web-warning is emitted.

test_results.entry_points: PASS — schedule-create-btn, create-group-btn (Groups tab) and create-paid-event-btn (Me tab) all route to /create-event.
test_results.basics_step: PASS — type-Game chip toggles; title-input filters continue (disabled at <=1 char, enabled at >1). Group chips only show g1/g2/g6 (Owner/Admin); g3/g4/g5 (Member) hidden as required. Continue background color goes from gray (rgb(243,244,246)) to brand green (rgb(5,150,105)) after title+group valid.
test_results.when_step: PASS — day-0..day-13, time-* chips, dur-60/90/120/150, rep-none/rep-weekly all functional. Selecting rep-weekly reveals wd-0..wd-6 toggles which correctly add/remove weekdays.
test_results.where_step: PASS — venue-<name> rows autofill venue-name-input + venue-address-input. Manual venue-name-input also works. Continue disabled until venue name > 1 char (verified: bg gray without venue, brand green after fill).
test_results.participation_step: PASS — mode-simple/mode-reg_free/mode-reg_paid all selectable. Selecting reg_free/reg_paid reveals capacity-input, waitlist-switch, close-24/48/168 chips, and the question builder (add-question-btn adds row with qfield-*, qtype-* toggling Text↔Yes/No, qremove-* removes).
test_results.payment_step: PASS — appears ONLY for mode-reg_paid (verified skipped for simple; step count went 5/6 straight from Participation to Extras). price-input filters non-numeric, method-paypal/method-venmo toggle. refund-input works.
test_results.extras_step: PASS — cover-0..cover-3 select highlighted cover; add-volunteer-btn adds row with vol-label-*, vol-plus-*, vol-minus-* (min clamped to 1); reminders-switch toggles.
test_results.review_step: PASS — Live NextUpCard preview renders; summary rows show Type/Group/When/Where/Joining/Capacity/Repeats. Paid fee card shows $4.99. Publish button text is 'Publish Event' for simple/free and 'Pay $4.99 & Publish' for paid.
test_results.publish_flow: PASS — Paid publish shows spinner ~1.4s then success. Simple publishes immediately. Success screen has create-done-btn ('View in Schedule').
test_results.end_to_end_persistence: PASS — After tapping create-done-btn user lands on Schedule; both created events ('League Match vs Northgate United' Riverside FC/paid and 'Simple RSVP Practice' Downtown Hoops/simple) are visible at the top of the list with correct group, venue, time and cover. Tapping the created event opens /event/ce-<timestamp> and getEvent returns the wizard-built EventItem (venue Test Field, 90 min duration, Downtown Hoops group all render correctly).
test_results.regression: PASS — Existing seed events still render (Open Play & Pizza Night with Register button, Shootaround & Scrimmage, etc.). RSVP Going/Maybe/Can't controls on simple events still tappable. All 5 bottom tabs (Home, Groups, Schedule, Market, Me) work.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: `groups.find((g) => g.id === groupId)` (create-event.tsx:81) searches all groups instead of adminGroups; harmless because groupId is always set from adminGroups, but could return undefined if adminGroups is empty — currently guarded by `group?.name ?? 'My Group'`.

Minor: `getEvent` (store.ts:159) uses `createdEvents.find` before declaration on line 164 due to hoisting via `let`. Works at runtime (function is only called after render) but is a fragile pattern; consider hoisting the `createdEvents` declaration above `getEvent`.
seed_data_creation: None — used in-memory store; wizard-created events auto-clear on reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wizard flow is stable. In-memory store persists created events across screens within a session via useSyncExternalStore. Full paid flow (7 steps) and simple/free flow (6 steps) both verified; publish → schedule → event detail integration confirmed working end-to-end.
